mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major objectives in animal breeding strategies."
Improved animal health is one of the major objectives in animal breeding strategies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication that one record for a particular trait is a good guide to future ones and therefore, waiting is hardly needed before culling decision could be taking."
A high repeatability estimate is an indication that one record for a particular trait is a good guide to future ones and therefore, waiting is hardly needed before culling decision could be taking.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the raw material the breeders need to make appropriate selection for herd improvement."
Variation is the raw material the breeders need to make appropriate selection for herd improvement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the square root of the variance; it is symbolised by σ for population and s for sample."
The standard deviation is the square root of the variance; it is symbolised by σ for population and s for sample.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of both the genetic and environmental variances; 2."
Heritability is a function of both the genetic and environmental variances; 2.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important part in animal breeding because it is the portion or part of the variance that is transferable from parents to offspring or from generation to generation."
The additive variance is the most important part in animal breeding because it is the portion or part of the variance that is transferable from parents to offspring or from generation to generation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a unit of heredity in a living organism."
Gene is a unit of heredity in a living organism.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compulsory introductory course that is design to introduce the basic principles and concepts of animal breeding and improvement of livestock to all Agricultural students in the third year."

Elementary Topics in Animal Breeding is a compulsory introductory course that is design to introduce the basic principles and concepts of animal breeding and improvement of livestock to all Agricultural students in the third year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in research studies, especially for the economically important traits in farm animals."
Numerous procedures for estimating heritability are used in research studies, especially for the economically important traits in farm animals.

GI
Generation interval (GI) is defined as the average age of the parents when their progeny are born.
______ is the tendency for successive records of the same animal to be more alike than those of different animals.
Repeatability
Repeatability is the tendency for successive records of the same animal to be more alike than those of different animals.
______ are those traits with continuous range of variation and do not fit into natural categories.
Quantitative traits
Quantitative traits are those traits with continuous range of variation and do not fit into natural categories.

Sex cells
Sex cells are known collectively as gametes (gamos, Greek, meaning marriage).

high repeatability

Qualitative traits

______ refers to the observable or measurable difference among individuals within a population for a particular trait.
Phenotypic variation
Phenotypic variation refers to the observable or measurable difference among individuals within a population for a particular trait.
